business_summary: Jiangxi Sanxin Medtec Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, sale, and service of medical devices. It offers infusion and cardiothoracic surgery products and blood purification products, such as central concentrate delivery systems, disposable biological protein glue dispensers, disposable blood dialyzers, hemodialysis filters, hemodialysis concentrates and powders, continuous blood purification pipelines and accessories, dialysis fluid filters, disposable dialysis indwelling needles, dialysis filtration machines, hemodialysis water production systems, centralized liquid supply systems, disposable hollow fiber dialyzers, hemodialysis extracorporeal circulation tubing, hemodialysis tubing, machine blood collection devices, blood purification and fluid replacement pipelines, and central venous catheter kits. It also provides prefilled catheter flushing devices, heparin caps, sterile needles, disposable filtration infusion sets, disposable light-shielded precision filtration infusion sets, blood transfusion devices, infusion disinfection connectors, Y-shaped indwelling needles, closed vein indwelling needles, pneumatic needle-free injectors, insulin syringes, injection needles, dispensing syringes, disposable sterile syringes, fixed-dose vaccine injectors, light-proof pressure extension tubes, positive pressure intravenous catheters, indwelling needles, and retractable self-destruct syringes. In addition, the company offers right heart suction heads, cardiopulmonary bypass connectors, blood clot filters, cold pump infusion devices, artificial heart-lung extracorporeal circulation tubing packages, and disposable blood storage and filtration devices. Further, it provides disposable balloon inflation pressure pumps, vascular sheath sets, and PTA high-pressure balloon dilation catheters, as well as medical needle-free injectors. Jiangxi Sanxin Medtec Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Nanchang, China.
